free_tier.stated: Two products on one site. Transfer: 'ファイル容量を無制限（1ファイル 250ギガ）、ファイル保存期限最大65日、完全無料'. Unlimited total, 250 GB per file, up to 65 days. Separate cloud-drive product: 10 GB free, 30 GB if you hold premium on IllustratorAC/PhotoAC/SilhouetteAC.

retention.stated: per-object-cap 250 GB; retention max 65 days; anonymous (browser-cache) uploads are deleted after 14 days

egress.terms: No metered bandwidth; funded by the AC illustration-marketplace family.

record.tooling: Web upload form only; no API and no rclone backend.
record.chaining: Account-less transfer allows 250 GB across unlimited objects with 65 days maximum retention in a re-upload cycle. The separate 10 GB cloud drive provides persistent storage.
record.limits_note: per-object-cap 250 GB; retention max 65 days; anonymous (browser-cache) uploads are deleted after 14 days. The 10 GB drive is separate from the transfer allowance and does not stack with it.
record.reliability_note: Run by the AC illustration-workspace group, so it is a marketing surface for their paid art subscriptions rather than a storage business. Historically stable, and the '10 GB free cloud' add-on is recent.
